mapper.select: SELECT c.category AS category, COUNT(*) AS comboCount, ROUND(AVG(c.price), 2) AS avgPrice, ROUND(AVG(c.calories), 0) AS avgCalories, SUM(c.sales_count) AS totalSales, ROUND(AVG(c.rating), 2) AS avgRating FROM mcd_combo c WHERE c.deleted = 0 AND c.status = 1 GROUP BY c.category ORDER BY totalSales DESC
